title_from_archive: For supply and installation of Trolley Mounted Vacuum Chamber with accessories, Last Date: 13-11-2026
notice_text: Page 1 of 2 School of Physics, University of Hyderabad, P.O. Central University, Prof. C.R. Rao Road, Gachibowli, Hyderabad- 500046 (India). Tel: 91-40-23134308; Fax: 91-40-23012800 School of Physics, University of Hyderabad Hyderabad – 500 046, INDIA Oct 14, 2026 NOTICE INVITING QUOTATION Ref. No. UoH/SoP/CARS-SDD-G /Prem/PUR/2026–2027/Equipment /Trolley mounted Vacuum Chamber with accessories Dear Sir/Madam: University of Hyderabad invites quotation for supply and installation of Trolley Mounted Vacuum Chamber with accessories as mentioned below as per Terms & Conditions of University of Hyderabad Purchase Policy. The quotations must reach to the official email of Dr. P. Prem Kiran, School of Physics, University of Hyderabad (email id: prem@uohyd.ac.in) at the earliest on or before 13 Nov 2026. The file size should be between 10-15 MB. Technical specifications of some of the critical features of the items are specified below: S. No. Description/Specifications Quantity 1 SS 304 Cylindrical chamber with ports as below (Dia 700mm Length-500mm approx) CF 100 port for pumping, CF 63 port- 8 nos CF 300 port- 3 nos, CF 35 port- 4 nos KF 25 port- 2 nos KF 25 Pressure relief valve – 1 no Nuts bolts for all flanges (1 set) Base Vacuum of 1´10-7 Torr to be demonstrated before shipping at the vendor facility. A team from UoH will be visiting the vendor facility for Pre-Dispatch Inspection. 1 2 255-260 ltr/sec or better Turbomolecular pump with 6 m3/h dry backing scroll pump (oil-free, hermetic) to achieve the required vacuum of the chamber & FPM sealed compact full range vacuum gauge on CF 35 with display 1 3 Frame for mounting the vacuum chamber, pumps, gauges with wheels and legs (MS Powder coated, Castor wheels, Levelling legs) 1 4 Lifter for dome. Hydraulic/Motorised lift and swivel 1 5 2D Vacuum stage with 50 mm translation (X-50 Z-50) & Rotation 360° with vacuum compatible motor and controller. The load capacity for translation stages must be ~ 100 N (Centered load), ~ 50 N (Axial load) For rotation stage the load capacity ~ 50 – 100 N (Normal load) 1 6 Copper gasket for all flanges (1 set) CF 100 1 no, CF 63 8 nos, CF 35 4 nos, 1 7 ETP copper gaskets or Teflon or Aluminium gaskets for CF 300 ports – 6 Nos 1 8 CF63 feedthrough flange of DB25 feed through to control the translation stages inside the vacuum chamber. Similar to P/N IFDGG251056X along with air side P/N FTADD25A and vacuum side PEEK P/N FTADD25 connectors. 1 9 Design, Testing & Shipping 1 Page 2 of 2 School of Physics, University of Hyderabad, P.O. Central University, Prof. C.R. Rao Road, Gachibowli, Hyderabad- 500046 (India). Tel: 91-40-23134308; Fax: 91-40-23012800 All systems should be robust enough to permit shifting from one lab to another without warranting elaborate procedures for system realignment/optimization. The laboratory, where the system will be housed, may or may not be provided with air conditioning and humidity is expected to be in the range of 50%-70%. It is expected that the whole system will perform satisfactorily under such lab conditions. Dust level also cannot be controlled to classify the lab as either class 1000/10000. Terms & Conditions: 1) Equipment offered should form a complete system. Plea that an item essentially required to form a complete operational system but not quoted since not specifically asked for in the Tender will not be accepted. An incomplete offer is liable to be rejected on that ground. 2) Bidder should be OEM of vacuum components with inhouse design and machining capability. 3) Bidder must produce certificate from Government Funded Institutions/Labs where a similar chamber with vacuum better or equal to1´10-7 Torr is demonstrated. 4) The vendor must design the entire unit and submit the design along with the quotes. 5) Pre-Dispatch Inspection is essential: A team from UoH will be visiting the vendor facility for Pre-Dispatch Inspection. 6) Installation and on-site training to user, if any, should be free of cost. 7) Service support available for on-site service of equipment must be provided. Details of the service staff (for the item quoted) with the manufacturer must be provided. 8) The products quoted must be new and refurbished products will not be acceptable under any circumstances. 9) Technical clarifications: Technical clarifications, if any, may be sought from us through our email prem@uohyd.ac.in, before submission of the formal quotation. 10) Prices: Separately indicate, basic cost of individual components, taxes, duties, packing & forwarding charges, transport & Insurance charges etc. wherever applicable. 11) Discount: Educational discounts and concessions, if any, should be clearly indicated in the quotation. Ours is an educational institution, please quote your best lowest price. 12) Validity: The rates quoted should be valid for a period of 120 days from the date of opening technical bids. 13) Payment: Within 30 days after satisfactory supply and installation. 14) The resultant contract will be interpreted under Indian Laws. 15) Bidders are not permitted to alter or modify their bids after the deadline for receipt of bids. 16) Delivery: To be delivered at O/o Dr. P. Prem Kiran, School of Physics, University of Hyderabad, Gachibowli, Hyderabad – 500046, Telangana, India. 17) Warranty/Guaranty: Warranty details for at least 3 years (5 years preferred) on the entire vacuum chamber system with accessories from the date of installation must be provided with terms & conditions of warranty. If any component of the equipment quoted is not covered by the warranty, the same must be specified. 18) The original airway bill for any/all imported items should be submitted for verification. 19) Liquidated Damages: The supplier shall pay to the University @ 1% of the total cost of the system/equipment/material per week of delay in delivery of the system which in no case shall exceed 5% of the total cost. 20) The purchase policy of University of Hyderabad is applicable for the entire procurement. (Dr. P. Prem Kiran)

This book of “General Conditions of Contract” is applicable to both types of tenders i.e.” Percentage rate tenders and Item rate tenders”. Accordingly, alternative provisions for conditions Nos. 4, 10 & 12 of the General Rules and Directions are given in this book. The appropriate alternatives will be applicable in specific cases depending on whether this is used for percentage rate tender (CPWD-7) or item rate tender (CPWD-8). 2. CPWD-6, Schedules A to F, special conditions/specifications and drawings only will be issued to intending bidders. The HCU-GCC 2016 form will not be issued along with the Tender Documents but the same shall form part of the agreement to be drawn and signed by both parties after acceptance of tender. Authority approving the Notice Inviting Tenders (NIT) shall fill up all the blanks in CPWD-6 and in Schedules B to F before issue of Tender Papers. 5. These are not to be filled in the Standard Form. The Schedules with all blanks, duly filled, shall be separately issued to all intending tenderers. Signature of the Contractor Page 8 Method of Tender Application, Tender Submission and Tender Opening The intending bidder must read the terms and conditions of CPWD-6 carefully. He should only submit his bid if he considers himself eligible and he is in possession of submission of all the required documents as per NIT. The following Technical and Finance bid documents shall be upload simultaneously with scanned copies in e-procurement web site. The tender documents may also be seen at University of Hyderabad website-www.uohyd.ac.in (A) Technical bid documents 1) The bidders except Micro and Small Medium Enterprises (MSEs) notified under (MSME) Policy (as per Rule 170 of GFR 2017), should pay EMD of 2% of Tendered amount (including GST) should be drawn in favor of “Finance Officer, University of Hyderabad” either in form of Bank Guarantee fixed deposit receipt of a bank/demand draft/banker check of a scheduled bank. The original EMD shall be placed in Envelope-1 and closed using suitable adhesive and shall be dropped in the Tender box before the bid opening date and time. The scanned copy of EMD shall be uploaded on the web site. Bids submitted along with EMD in the prescribed form shall be considered for further evaluation of eligibility Criteria. Bids submitted without EMD shall be summarily rejected. The Technical bid shall contain all the documents scanned and uploaded in the concerned web site, based on which the bidder claim to be eligible as per eligibility criteria prescribed in NIT. Any discloser of finance bid in the technical bid documents will lead to summary rejection of bid. 2) Work experience certificates as per Eligibility criteria. 3) Contract registration certificate issued by State or Central Govt., Departments or state/central autonomous bodies undertaking. 4) PAN card & GST Registration Certificate. 5) Latest Income Tax returns for the consecutive three financial years. Immediately preceding the tender date. 6) Turnover Certificate for the consecutive three financial years. Immediately preceding the tender date duly certified by the Chartered Accountants. 7) Undertaking as per Form “J”. 8) Other necessary documents as per Tender documents. On the due date of opening, the Technical bid of those tenderer who furnished valid EMD will only be opened. On opening of Technical bid, further detailed scrutiny/evaluation will be carried out. During the evaluation of techno commercial bids, the documents furnished by the tenderers will be scrutinized in detail. Any tender, found as not fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be rejected at this stage and such offers will not be considered for further processing. The price bid of only those tenderers who have been qualified during the scrutiny and technical evaluation will be opened separately on a specified date (with due intimation to the qualified bidders) and further processed, as per tender procedure/stipulations. Signature of the Contractor Page 9 Eligibility Criteria and Notice Inviting tender: (1) The bidder shall be a registered/enlisted contractor and should produce definite proof of registration/enlistment under appropriate class issued registered by state or central government departments or state/central autonomous bodies or undertakings. (2) Experience Criteria (Eligibility criteria for participation in tendering). Estimate Cost of the work is Rs. 23,42,979/-(including of GST) (a) Bidders should have satisfactorily completed during last 07 years ending last day of the month prior to the month in which the tenders are invited. (i) One work of Similar Expansion Joints Completed work of 80% of Estimated cost i.e Rs. 18,74,383/- (including of GST) (OR) (ii) Two works of Similar Expansion Joints Completed works each costing not less 50% of Estimated cost i.e. Rs. 11,71,490/- including of GST) (OR) (iii) Three works of Similar Expansion Joints Completed works each costing not less than 40% of Estimated cost i.e Rs. 9,37,192/- (including of GST)Self-Attested copies of experience certificates are to be submitted. (3) Only work completed and certified by competent authority of the organization will be accepted as Experience Certificate. Certificate not issued in the name of bidder (Contractor) or issued by an authority not competent to issue such certificate will not be accepted. Mere work order or purchase order etc issued will not qualify for experience. (3a) The copies of relevant IT returns and Auditor Certified Turnover Certificate for the consecutive three financial years, immediately preceding the tender date. PAN Card, GST Registration certificate should accompany the technical bid. (4) The contractors who were penalized under clause No (2) of General Conditions of Contract during the last one year in UoH campus works will be disqualified and their Technical /Financial bids will not be accepted. (5) Should have had average Annual Financial turnover not less than Rs. 7,02,894/- i.e., 30% of the estimated cost of the work during the last three years ending 31st March 2025. (6) To become eligible for issue of tender, the tenderer shall have to furnish an undertaking, as perform ‘J’ of the NIT. Signature of the Contractor Page 10 (7) Agreement shall be drawn with the successful tenderer in the prescribed Form No. CPWD 7/8 which is available in the University of Hyderabad website. Tenderer shall quote his rates as per various terms and conditions of the said form which will form part of the agreement. (8) The time allowed for carrying out the work is 02Months from the start date as defined in clause 5 Scheduled “F” or from the first date of handing over of the site, whichever is later, in accordance with phasing if any indicated in the tender document. The site shall be made available as and when required for execution of work. (9)(a) Tenders shall be accompanied with Earnest money of 2% of estimated cost put to tender/in the receipt of fixed deposit receipt /demand draft/banker check of a scheduled bank issued in favour of Finance Officer, University of Hyderabad payable at Hyderabad. (b) Defect liability period of six (06) months after satisfactory completion of work. (10) The Bidder/contractor, whose tender is accepted, will be required to furnish performance Guarantee of 5% (Five Percent) of the tendered amount within the period specified in Schedule F. This guarantee shall be in the form of cash (in case guarantee amount is less than Rs. 10,000/-) or Deposit at Call receipt of any scheduled bank/Banker’s cheque of any scheduled bank/Demand Draft of any scheduled bank/Pay order of any scheduled bank (in case guarantee amount is less than Rs. 1,00,000/-) Government Securities or Fixed Deposit Receipts or Guarantee Bonds of any Scheduled Bank in accordance with the prescribed form. In case the contractor fails to deposit the said performance guarantee within the period as indicated in Schedule “F” including the extended period if any, the Earnest Money deposited by the contractor shall be forfeited automatically without any notice to the contractor. (11) The description of the work is as follows: Copies of other drawing and documents pertaining to the works will be open for inspection by the tenderers at the office of above mentioned officer. Tenderers are advised to inspect and examine the building and its area surroundings and satisfy themselves before submitting their tenders. The tenderer shall be responsible for arranging and maintaining at his own cost all materials, tools & plants, water, required for executing the work unless otherwise services provided for in the contract documents. Submission of a specific electricity access, facilities for workers and all other tender by a tenderer implies that he has read this notice and all other contract documents and has made himself aware of the scope and specifications of the work to be done. (12) The competent authority on behalf of the University of Hyderabad does not bind himself to accept the lowest or any other tender and reserves himself the authority to reject any or all Page 11 Signature of the Contractor the tenders received without the assignment of any reason. All tenders in which any of the prescribed condition is not fulfilled or any condition including that of conditional rebate is put forth by the tenderer shall be summarily rejected. (13) Canvassing whether directly or indirectly, in connection with tenderers is strictly prohibited and the tenders submitted by the contractors who resort to canvassing will be liable to rejection. (14) The University Engineer on behalf of the competent authority of University reserves to himself the right of accepting the whole or any part of the tender and the tenderer shall be bound to perform the same at the rate quoted. (15) No Engineer of Gazette rank or other Gazetted Officer employed in Engineering or Administrative duties in an Engineering Department of the Government of India is allowed to work as a contractor for a period of one year after his retirement from Government service, without the previous permission of the Government of India in writing. This contract is liable to be cancelled if either the contractor or any of his employees is found any time to be such a person who had not obtained the permission of the Government of India as aforesaid before submission of the tender or engagement in the contractor’s service. (16) The tender for the works shall remain open for acceptance for a period of 90 days from the date of opening of tenders/Ninety days from the date of opening of financial bid. If any bidder withdraws his tender before the said period or issue of letter of acceptance, whichever is earlier, or makes any modifications in the terms and conditions of the tender which are not acceptable to the department, then the Government shall, without prejudice to any other right or remedy, be at liberty to forfeit of the said earnest money as aforesaid. Further the tenderer shall not be allowed to participate in the retendering process of the work. (17) The Contractor should furnish the contact telephone/cell phone numbers of self and their supervisors to the institute. The normal working hours shall be from 9.00 am to 5.30 pm on all seven days of the week but if required, the Contractor should execute the works beyond the normal working hours/ as per the requirement of the institute. notice_text: UNIVERSITY OF HYDERABAD ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT Office of the Assistant Engineer NOTE Ref: UH/ENGG/UE/2026-27/ Date: 20.08.2026. The Opening of Quotations (Below Rs. 50,000/-) for the works mentioned below is scheduled to be held on 24.08.2026 at 12.00 P.M. in the Office of the University Works Department. Hence, All the contractors are requested to remind the following details: - Submission of Quotations: 24.08.2026 at 12.00 PM Opening of Quotations: 24.08.2026 at 3.00 PM S. No Name of the work Estimated Cost Rs. 1 Replacement of damaged borewell GI Pipe line with CPVC pipe line in Garden area at Administrative building in University of Hyderabad Campus– Reg. Rs. 49,622/- Sd/- Assistant Engineer (E) S. No Description of item Qty Unit Rate in figures & Rate in words Amount 1 Providing and fixing Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride (CPVC) pipes, having thermal stability for hot & cold water supply including all CPVC plain & brass threaded fittings. This includes jointing of pipes & fittings with one step CPVC solvent cement, trenching, refilling & testing of joints complete as per direction of Engineer in Charge : External work 1.1 40 mm nominal dia Pipes 60 Mtr Figure:Rs____________________ Words:Rupees______________________________ 2 Providing and fixing of Schneider make 3 Pole AC Contactor (1NO+1NC), 12A, 5.5KW incluindg removing of old one etc as required. 2 Each Figure:Rs____________________ Words:Rupees______________________________ __ ____________________________ 3 Providing and fixing of Schneider make 3 Pole Thermal Magnetic Circuit Breaker having Push button control, 9-14A & 6kA breaking capacity incluindg removing of old one etc as required. 1 Each Figure:Rs____________________ Words:Rupees______________________________ __ ____________________________ 11. A.E (E) has to enclose the work completion certificate and user department certificate along with the bill. 12. No quotation will be accepted without PAN/VAT no. 13. TDS (1% or 2%) / Labor welfare cess (1%) will be levied wherever applicable. Signature of the Contractor Assistant Engineer(E-I) 1. The contractor/ bidder shall be a registered contractor and should produce definite proof of appropriate class registered by state or central government departments or state/central autonomous bodies or undertakings should submit proof thereof. 2. The work should be completed within Twenty-one (21) days from the date of issue of work order. Failure to complete the work within the stipulated time will entail recovery of compensation from work bills as decided by the 3. The contractor should abide by the Labor Laws, Minimum Wages Act & Workmen’s Compensation Act. 4. This work order can be cancelled and the work stopped at any time by the Officer-in-charge of the work or by any Officer superior to him in authority. 5. The contractor shall permit the University at the time of making intermediate payment(s) to deduct 10% of the value of the work billed for towards Security Deposit. The deposit is liable to be forfeited for non-rectification of defects pointed out to him during the execution of the work/Defect Liability Period. 7. If water is supplied by the University 1% of the actual cost of water consuming items will be recovered from the bills for work done. 8. Seignories charges will be deducted from the bill as per the stipulated rates communicated by the Govt. from time to time. 9. Defect liability period 6 (six) months from the date of completion of the work. 10. For delay or slow progress of work the relevant clauses of CPWD manual will be invoked and penalty levied. 6. The work shall be done as per CPWD specifications and as directed by the University Engineer from time to time. Add GST @18% Total Terms & Conditions: Name of Work:-Replacement of damaged borewell GI Pipe line with CPVC pipe line in Garden area at Administrative building in University of Hyderabad Campus– Reg. 1) The estimate amount is inclusive of GST. 2) Comparative statement for Quoted rates shall be based on rates inclusive of GST. SCHEDULE OF QUANTITIES Sub Total

notice_text: हैदराबाद विश्िविद्यालय | University of Hyderabad प्रो. सी.आर.राव रोड, गच्चीबावली सेंट्रल यूनिवर्सिटी पी.ओ., हैदराबाद – 500 046 तेलंगाणा राज्य, भारत. कुलसचचव का कायािलय हहंदी कक्ष सं. हह.क./24/प्रो.यो./2025-26/1155 हद. 24.07.2026 ववषय: वषि 2025-26 के दौराि मूल रूप में हहंदी में काम (भौनतक अथवा इलेक्ट्ट्रॉनिक रूप में) करिे के र्लए प्रोत्साहि योजिा। - - - भारत सरकार, राजभाषा ववभाग, िई हदल्ली के हदिांक 14.09.2016 के कायािलय ज्ञापि सं.12013/01/2011-रा.भा(िीनत) के प्रावधािों के अिुसार वषि 2025-26 के दौराि मूल रूप में हहंदी में काम (भौनतक अथवा इलेक्ट्ट्रॉनिक रूप में) करिे के र्लए प्रोत्साहि योजिा के अधीि ववश्वववद्यालय के नियर्मत कार्मिकों से प्रववष्टटयााँ आमंत्रित की जाती हैं। इस प्रोत्साहि योजिा की अवचध 01.04.2025 से 31.03.2026 तक की है। प्रोत्साहि योजिा के अधीि ‘ग’ क्षेि में हहंदी में अपिा अचधकाचधक कायि मूल रूप में हहंदी में करिे वाले [कम से कम 10,000 शब्द र्लखिे वाले] कार्मिकों को निम्िर्लखखत 10 पुरस्कार प्रदाि ककए जाएाँगे. क्रम सं. पुरस्कार की श्रेणी पुरस्कारों की संख्या पुरस्कार की राशि (₹) 1. प्रथम पुरस्कार 02 पुरस्कार प्रत्येक 5000/- 2. द्ववतीय पुरस्कार 03 पुरस्कार प्रत्येक 3000/- 3. तृतीय पुरस्कार 05 पुरस्कार प्रत्येक 2000/- इस प्रोत्साहि योजिा में भाग लेिे के र्लए अचधकाररयों/कमिचाररयों से अिुरोध है कक वे उक्ट्त अवचध के बीच ककए गए अपिे कायों का वववरण संलग्ि ववहहत प्रपि में भर कर एवं अपिे अिुभाग प्रमुख से सत्यावपत करवा कर हदिांक 14.08.2026 तक ‘हहंदी कक्ष’ र्भजवािे का कटट करें. अिुलग्िक :- उपरोक्ट्तािुसार कुलसचिि सेवा में, 1. सभी संकाय/ववभाग/केंद्र/अिुभाग में पररचालि हेतु 2. वेबमास्टर – वव.वव. की वेबसाइट पर पररपि को अपलोड करिे एवं सभी कमिचाररयों को इंट्रा वेबमेल/जी एप्स के माध्यम से भेजिे के अिुरोध के साथ / हैदराबाद विश्िविद्यालय | University of Hyderabad प्रो. सी.आर.राव रोड, गच्चीबावली सेंट्रल यूनिवर्सिटी पी.ओ., हैदराबाद – 500 046 तेलंगाणा राज्य, भारत. Central University, HYDERABAD – 500046 upto 3.00 PM on 02.06.2026. Sd/- ASSISTANT ENGINEER (E) Sd/- UNIVERSITY ENGINEER 2 General Conditions & Eligibility Criteria for Submission of Quotation:- 1. The contractor/bidder shall be a registered one under appropriate class and should produce definite proof of registration with State or Central Government Departments or State/Central Autonomous Bodies or Undertakings / Shall be registered with MSME under appropriate category. 2. The bidder should also submit self-attested copies of relevant IT returns, PAN no, valid Registration Certificate and Experience certificate having successfully completed Civil works of required value and shall sign all the pages of Technical & price bid without fail. 3. The bidders except Micro and Small Medium Enterprises (MSEs) notified under MSME, Procurement Policy (as per Rule 170 of GFR 2017), should pay EMD of 2% of Estimated Cost drawn in favor of “Finance Officer, University of Hyderabad” payable at Hyderabad. 4. Statutory taxes/Deductions shall be made as per rules. 5. The Competent Authority on behalf of the University of Hyderabad does not bind itself to accept the lowest or any other quotations and reserves to itself the right to reject any or all the quotations received without assigning any reason. All quotations in which any of the prescribed condition is not fulfilled or any condition including those related to conditional rebate put forth by the tenderer shall be summarily rejected 6. Work to be carried out in the presence and under supervision of UWD Engineers. 7. The site will be made available as and when required for execution of work. 8. Canvassing whether directly or indirectly, in connection with tenders is strictly prohibited and the quotations submitted by the contractors who resort to canvassing will be liable for rejection. 9. The Contractor should abide by the Labour Laws, Minimum Wages Act & Workmen’s compensation Act. 10. The Work Order can be cancelled and the work can be stopped at any time by the Engineer-in-charge of the work or by any officer superior to him in authority. 11. The contractor shall permit the University to deduct 5% of the value of each work bill towards Security Deposit inaddition to performance guaranty which shall be released after expiry of defects liability period. The deposit is liable to be forfeited to the University for Non-rectification of defects pointed out to him during execution of work/Defect Liability Period. 16. Defect liability period of (06) Month’s commences from the date of satisfactory completion of work. 17. For delay or slow progress of work, relevant clauses of CPWD manual will be invoked and penalty Will be levied. If work is delayed, the University reserves the right to foreclose / rescind the work, and to get the balance work done through any other contractor, at his risk and cost and the Contractor shall have no right to claim any compensation on this account. 18. In case, the work cannot be started due to reasons not within the control of the contractor within 1/8th of the stipulated time for completion of work, either party may close the contract. In such eventuality, the Earnest Money Deposit of the contractor shall be refunded, but no payment on account of interest, loss of profit or damages etc. shall be payable. 19. The Contractor should ensure while executing the work that there should be no deviation / variation beyond permissible limit. 20. The work of each item is to be executed in consultation with the user Department. 21. Certificate of satisfactory completion of work from user department and or Engineer in charge may be obtained and enclosed to the final bill for payment. 24. Further details if any can be had from the Office of the University Engineer, University of Hyderabad, Hyderabad-5000 046 during working hours. 25. GST invoice form should be filled and submitted along with the bill. 26. Labour engaged and working equipment brought to site by the contractor shall be recorded in the UoH Security main gate and necessary gate pass obtained before entering in to the premises. Hyderabad 500 046 Phones: +91-40-23134818(O) Fax : +91-40-23012460 E-Mail : pradeepta.panda@uohyd.ac.in Ref. No. UH/Chem/Stores/2026/Low Temperature Immersion Cooler-PKP/003 dated 21 May 2026 NOTICE INVITING TENDER (NIT) Sealed bids (Technical and Commercial documents in separate sealed covers; two bid system) should reach the office of Prof. Pradeepta K. Panda, School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad on or before by 5:00 PM, 11th June 2026. Quotations are invited from Indian manufacturers/ suppliers/ vendors for the supply, installation and commissioning of “Low Temperature Immersion Cooler”. Technical specifications Kindly ensure the warranty of the goods for at least a period of 3 years, preferably 5 years. Accordingly, the following Schedule will be followed: Opening of Technical bids on 12th June, 2026 at 4.00 PM Opening of Commercial bids 12th June, 2026 at 4.30 PM a) Ergonomic Design & Easy Operation b) Working Temperature Range: -80 to 25 C c) Temp. control accuracy: +1C d) Cooling compressor: 2-stage e) Cooling capacity: min. 70 w @ -80 C f) Pressure Safety Switch: Built in Protection for the Compressor from Excess Pressure g) Over Heat Protection: Built in Protection for the Compressor from Over Heat. h) Built in Digital Temperature display and selection i) Bath size: Suitable for 2 Liter round-bottomed flask Prof. Pradeepta K. Panda School of Chemistry University of Hyderabad Central University P. O. Hyderabad 500 046 Phones: +91-40-23134818(O) Fax : +91-40-23012460 E-Mail : pradeepta.panda@uohyd.ac.in Terms & Conditions: 1. The Reference No. of the Notice Inviting Tender dated should be clearly mentioned on all sealed envelopes and any correspondence including e-mails with the University. 2. Educational Discounts: If any, should be clearly indicated in the quotation. 3. The bids should be complete in all aspects. All specific technical details requested should be provided along with supporting document where applicable. All specifications and representative high resolution imaging examples must be available in publicly available brochures, data sheets or websites. 4. Specifications: Bidders are requested to carefully go through the specifications given in the tender and quote only when they are sure they have the product specified to offer. 5. Mode of Submission: All pages of the tender document must be signed by the authorized representatives of bidder, in token of having accepted the terms and conditions incorporated in the tender notice. Hand-written (manuscript) bids and bids submitted through e-mail shall not be accepted 6. Sealed Two bid system which are required to be submitted in two parts as Technical (consisting of all technical details along with terms and conditions) and Commercial (financial bid indicating item-wise price for the items mentioned in the technical bid). 7. Certificate from original manufacturers: The bid should be received from the Indian equipment manufacturers/ suppliers. Tenders received from foreign manufacturers will be rejected. 8. Make and Model: Vendor/Supplier is required to clearly mention the make, model, size and other specifications along with the unit price. Appropriate original brochures for each item providing full technical details must be attached to enable their verification. 9. Bidder details: Complete correspondence address, phone numbers and email ids, and website details (if any), must be clearly mentioned in the technical bid documents. The Firms should mention their GSTIN, PAN, registration number etc. on the quotations wherever applicable. 10. Validity of Bids: Minimum period of 90 days from the date of opening of the financial bids. 11. Basic Price: Indicate price per unit on FOR, UoH, Hyderabad basis. 12. Taxes (GST): The bidder should clearly indicate all applicable taxes separately for each item along with HSN Code and then arrive at a total price of all the items indicated in the Notice Inviting Tender. Prof. Pradeepta K. Panda School of Chemistry University of Hyderabad Central University P. O. Hyderabad 500 046 Phones: +91-40-23134818(O) Fax : +91-40-23012460 E-Mail : pradeepta.panda@uohyd.ac.in 13. Other charges: The bidder should clearly indicate all applicable other charges, if any, separately viz., transportation, packing, loading, unloading, insurance, installation, commissioning, testing, training, etc. 14. Spare Parts: Bidder must indicate whether he/she is willing to give an undertaking that all spare parts for the equipment quoted will be applied as and when ordered for at least a period of 10 years from the date of installation and inability to supply the spare parts due of obsolescence of the equipment will not be pleaded. 15. Technical clarification: If any, may be sought from us through our email: pradeepta.panda@uohyd.ac.in before submission of formal bid. 16. Risk purchase clause: If the supplier fails to deliver the order material with in the stipulated delivery period specified in the purchase order the mentioned items and in such a manner as deemed appropriate, goods or services similar to those undelivered, and the supplier will be liability to the university for any excess cost for such similar goods or services. 17. Lowest quote: All the bids will be evaluated based on the technical specifications given in advertisement and from the technically qualified bids, the lowest quote will be selected. 18. Courier/Postal: University of Hyderabad will not be holding any responsibility for any delay. 19. Invalid Tenders: Incomplete tenders and bids received after 5:00 PM on the due date and sent by fax/email will be summarily rejected. 20. Payment terms: 100 % after delivery, satisfactory installation, commissioning, testing and training (if any), against submission of valid TAX Invoice (with HSN code) with GSTIN number of the supplier. 21. Delivery Location: To Room No. W-105, School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad, Gachibowli, Hyderabad 500046, Telangana State. 22. The right to consider/reject: any quotations rests solely with the University of Hyderabad. 23. Purchase processes: Will strictly follow the University of Hyderabad purchase procedure UHPP.

Minutes of the 97th AC 6 of 21 e The Chairperson thanked the members whose term on the Council was completed and expressed appreciation for the services rendered by them to the Council. Then the agenda was taken up for discussion. Item 1.1. Confirmation of the Minutes of the 96th AC meeting. Since no comments/observations have been received from the members, the Minutes of the 96th meeting of the Academic Council held on 03rdOctober, 2025 have been confirmed. 1.2. Action Taken Report on the Minutes of the 96th Academic Council meeting. The action taken on the Minutes of the 96thmeeting of the Academic Council held on 03rdOctober, 2025 have been noted by the Council. The Council was informed by the Controller of Examinations i/c that all the effofis are being made to see that the admission counselling for all P.G. programmes are held online through the SAMARTH portal for the July session of Academic Year 2026-27. REPORTING ITEMS Item No.AC:97:2026:02: Letters/Public Notices and Regulations received from the UGC/M0E/AICTE/NTA/NCTE, etc., letters/public regulations (i) The important notices and received from UGC/MoE/AICTE/NTA/NCTE etc. presented in the Agenda item have been noted by the Council. With regard to the letter received from the Joint Secretary, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment for establishment of Dr. Ambedkar Centre of Excellence(DACE) at UOH under the Scheme of "Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme", the Dean, Student's Welfare informed the Council that the Committee for implementation of DACE has been set up and the recommendations of the same will be submitted to the Council during its next meetino. (ii) Regulations issued by the UGC: The Council resolved that a Committee may be constituted to examine for University level implementation of the UGC regulations- UGC (Minimum Standards of Instruction for the Grant of Undergraduate Degree and Postgraduate Degree) Regulations, 2025 dated 26/03/2025 and University Grants Commission (Recognition and Grant of Equivalence to Qualifications Obtained From Foreign Educational Institutions) Regulations, 2025 dated 04/04/2025. Item No.AC:97:2026:03: Report on admissions to the January session and January Extension session of Ph.D. Programmes for the Academic Year 2025-26: Minutes of the 97th AC The report presented by the Controller of Examinations on admission to Ph.D. programmes for the January and January Extension session of the Academic Year 2025-26 was considered and approved by the Council. It was further resolved that for the Ph.D. admissions of the A.Y. 2026-27, the academic units may opt for one of the following two modes of admission i.e., through UoH Entrance Exam or JRF * in July and January 1. 2. through UGC NET/CSIR UGC NET in March and August *Categories 2 and 3 will not be considered for this mode. The Council reaffirmed its decision with regard to the rationalization of marks of NET qualified candidates. Accordingly, the method of rationalization of marks of NET qualified candidates will continue to be followed as per the Notification Dated 28/07/2025. Item No.AC:97:2026:04: Payment of Scholarship under Direct Beneficiary Transfer (DBT) Mode by the Social Welfare Department of State of Telangana to SC category students from the Academic Year 2024-25 onwards. In light of the G.O.Ms. No. 6, dated 06-09-2024 of Government of Telangana stating that the entire scholarship amount including the Tuition Fee (RTF) and Maintenance Allowance (MTF) pertaining to the SC students will be paid into the account of the students through Aadhar Payment Bridge System (APBS) by Direct Beneficiary Transfer(DBT) for implementation w.e.f 2024-25 academic year onwards, the Council reiterated its previous decision as notified by Circular dated 11/06/2025. Thus, the students belonging to SC category shall not be entitled for concession in payment of fee despite the fact they may be drawing social welfare scholarships through TS ePass since they are not considered to be 'Scholarship Holders' in terms of norms of the University. Therefore, all SC category students are to pay full amount of fee at par with unreserved category from the academic year 2024-25. The matter shall also be reported to the Finance Committee. Item No.AC:97:2026:05: Non-compliance of minimum credit requirements per semester as prescribed by the NEP 2020. The Council noted that as per NEP 2020, all UG/PG/Integrated PG students are required to complete a minimum of 20 credits per semester and 40 credits per academic year towards their degree/diploma. It was reported by the Controller of Examinations that some of the students were found to be deficient in this requirement and this fact was notified by a Notice dated 02/02/2026. The matter was noted by the Council with an advice to all the academic units to comply and O Minutes of the 97th AC 8 of 21 implement the same. It was also resolved that the GECs are not to be substituted for making up deficit credits. ITEMS FOR CONSIDERATION Item No.AC:97:2026:06: Academic Calendar for the year 2026-27 After a discussion regarding the UGC Regulations regarding minimum teaching hours and teaching days in an Academic Year, the Council decided to refer the item back to the Committee for redrafting of Academic Calendar for the year 2026-27 by inconjorating the suggestions made by the members for modifications taking into account the time required for internships for the students. Item No.AC:97:2026:07: Prospectus for the Academic Year 2026-27 The Council noted the Prospectus 2026-27 and changes are to be submitted within a week days for incorporation and publication on the website. Item No.AC:97:2026:08: Wards of Defence Personnel quota in PG/Int PG admissions - Implementation of priority of category within the DP quota. The priority list vide Ministry of Defence letter No. F.No.6(1)/2017/D/(Res.11), dated May 21, 2018 for the supernumermy seats for Wards of Defence Personnel is approved by the Council for implementation from Academic Year 2026-27. Accordingly, the merit list shall be drawn from within the candidates of respective categories in the following order. Priority I. Widows/Wards of Defence personnel killed in action Priority II. Wards of Defence Personnel disabled in action and boarded out from service with disability attributable to military service. Priority III. Widows/Wards of Defence Personnel who died while in peace time with death attributable to military service. Priority IV. Wards of Defence Personnel disabled in service and boarded out with disability attributable to military service. Priority V. Wards of Serving/Ex-servicemen including personnel of police forces who are in receipt of Gallantry Awards. (1). ParamVir Chakra (2). Ashok Chakra (3). Mahavir Chakra (4). Kilti Chakra Minutes of the 97th AC 9 of 21 (5). Vir Chakra (6). Shaurya Chakra (7). President„s Police Medal for Gallantry (8). Sena Medal (Gallantry), NauSena Medal (Gallantry), VayuSena Medal (Gallantry) (9). Mention-in- Dispatches (10).Police Medal for Gallantry. Priority VI. Wards of Ex-Servicemen. Priority VII. Ex-servicemen and serving personnel who are in receipt of Gallantry Awards. Priority VIII. Wards of Serving Personnel. Priority IX*. Wives of Serving Personnel Item No.AC:97:2026:09:Nomination of External Member to the Academic Council. O Members of the Council were requested to send the nominations whose candidatures may be considered by the Vice-Chancellor for nomination as external member on to the Council. O Item No.AC:97:2026:10: Conducting admissions for Ph.D. programmes two times in an academic year from 2026-27 based on mode of admission. The Council noted that the admissions for Ph.D. programmes are being held currently twice a year i.e. in July and January and in two different modes, that is, through the entrance examinations and based on UGC-NET/UGC-CSIR-NET scores. It was also noted by the Council that the exams for UGC-NET/UGC-CSIR-NET are held in December and June months every year and the results/ranks of the same are declared somewhere around in March and August months and due to mismatch with the schedule of NET exams and the admission schedule of the University, the candidates qualifying in these exams are not getting opportunity to apply for admission into the University of Hyderabad. Considering the above fact in view, the academic units which are opting for admissions based NET scores are desiring to align Minutes of the 97th AC 10 of 21 the admission schedule of the University such that the candidates qualified in NET may submit their application immediately after the results of the same are notified. Accordingly, the Council resolved that the Ph.D admissions from the A.Y. 2026-27 be held in two modes as under: 1. For the academic units which opt for the UoH Entrance Exam - in July and January respectively. 2. Forthe academic units which opt for the and August respectively. The Reference No. of the Notice Inviting Tender dated should be clearly mentioned on all sealed envelopes and any correspondence including e-mails with the University. 2. Educational Discounts: If any, should be clearly indicated in the quotation. 3. The bids should be complete in all aspects. All specific technical details requested should be provided along with supporting document where applicable. All specifications and representative high resolution imaging examples must be available in publicly available brochures, data sheets or websites. 4. Specifications: Bidders are requested to carefully go through the specifications given in the tender and quote only when they are sure they have the product specified to offer. 5. Mode of Submission: All pages of the tender document must be signed by the authorized representatives of bidder, in token of having accepted the terms and conditions incorporated in the tender notice. Hand-written (manuscript) bids and bids submitted through e-mail shall not be accepted 6. Sealed Two bid system which are required to be submitted in two parts as Technical (consisting of all technical details along with terms and conditions) and Commercial (financial bid indicating item-wise price for the items mentioned in the technical bid). 7. Certificate from original manufacturers: The bid should be received from the Indian equipment manufacturers/ suppliers. Tenders received from foreign manufacturers will be rejected. 8. Make and Model: Vendor/Supplier is required to clearly mention the make, model, size and other specifications along with the unit price. Appropriate original brochures for each item providing full technical details must be attached to enable their verification. 9. Bidder details: Complete correspondence address, phone numbers and email ids, and website details (if any), must be clearly mentioned in the technical bid documents. The Firms should mention their GSTIN, PAN, registration number etc. on the quotations wherever applicable. 10. Validity of Bids: Minimum period of 90 days from the date of opening of the financial bids. 11. Basic Price: Indicate price per unit on FOR, UoH, Hyderabad basis. 12. Taxes (GST): The bidder should clearly indicate all applicable taxes separately for each item along with HSN Code and then arrive at a total price of all the items indicated in the Notice Inviting Tender. Prof. Pradeepta K. Panda School of Chemistry University of Hyderabad Central University P. O. Spare Parts: Bidder must indicate whether he/she is willing to give an undertaking that all spare parts for the equipment quoted will be applied as and when ordered for at least a period of 10 years from the date of installation and inability to supply the spare parts due of obsolescence of the equipment will not be pleaded. 15. Technical clarification: If any, may be sought from us through our email: pradeepta.panda@uohyd.ac.in before submission of formal bid. 16. Risk purchase clause: If the supplier fails to deliver the order material with in the stipulated delivery period specified in the purchase order the mentioned items and in such a manner as deemed appropriate, goods or services similar to those undelivered, and the supplier will be liability to the university for any excess cost for such similar goods or services. 17. Lowest quote: All the bids will be evaluated based on the technical specifications given in advertisement and from the technically qualified bids, the lowest quote will be selected. 18. Courier/Postal: University of Hyderabad will not be holding any responsibility for any delay. 19. Invalid Tenders: Incomplete tenders and bids received after 5:00 PM on the due date and sent by fax/email will be summarily rejected. 20. Payment terms: 100 % after delivery, satisfactory installation, commissioning, testing and training (if any), against submission of valid TAX Invoice (with HSN code) with GSTIN number of the supplier. 21. Delivery Location: To Room No. W-105, School of Chemistry, University of Hyderabad, Gachibowli, Hyderabad 500046, Telangana State. 22. The right to consider/reject: any quotations rests solely with the University of Hyderabad. 23. Purchase processes: Will strictly follow the University of Hyderabad purchase procedure UHPP.

notice_text: / University of Hyderabad efu&f, Office of the Dean, Students' Welfare Email: dsw-office@uohyd.ac.in Ref.: No.U0H/DSW/2026 Phone: 040-23132500 25.02.2026 Appeal to the student community It has come to the attention that posters belonging to a student organisation bearing the picture of the highly revered leader were recently set on fire near the Amphi Theatre. Personalities who are held in high esteem as leaders, revered for their principles and lifelong dedication to human progress, must be honoured for their legacy by upholding the values they championed. Such acts of disrespect undermine the inclusive spirit of our university, that thrives on social and cultural diversity. We vehemently and unequivocally condemn the actions of any pelpetrator involved in this unethical act. A thorough investigation is in place and we are treating this matter seriously. The university will not tolerate any individual/group of individuals involved in this unjustified behaviour. As a campus that celebrates diversity and mutual respect, we are all responsible for fostering an environment where every organisation and individual is valued. Please be mindful of the potential social and cultural impact of disrespectful behaviour towards the banners and posters of National leaders. The student community is urged to avoid such disrespectful acts and to uphold our shared values of respect and inclusivity. Any student/group of students found engaging in any such disrespectful behaviour and vandalising acts, is subject to disciplinary action. To All the Concerned Dean, Students' Welfare DEAN STUDENTS WELFARE UNIVERSITY OF HYDERABAD HYDERABAD-500046, T.s. INDIA.

notice_text: UNIVERSITY OF HYDERABAD University Works Department Office of the Executive Engineer University of Hyderabad Central University P.O Hyderabad 500 046, Ph: 23132300 NOTE Ref: UH/ENGG/UE/2026-27/ Date: 29.01.2026 .12.2026 The Opening of Quotations (Below Rs. 50,000/-) for the above works mentioned below is scheduled to be held on 04.02.2026 at 12.00 PM in the Office of the University Works Department. Hence, all the contractors are requested to remind the following details. Submission of Quotations - 04.02.2026 up to 12.00 PM Opening of Quotations - 04.02.2026 at 3.00 PM S. No Name of the work Estimated Cost 1 Maintenance of buildings:’’ Welcome maintenance to B- 08 Qtrs.’’ in UoH campus Rs. 47,222/- Sd/- Executive Engineer 2 Name of work :- Maintenanace of Buildings- "Welcome maintenance to B-08 Quarter " in UoH Campus. 1) The estimate amount is inclusive of GST. 2) Comparative statement for Quoted rates shall be based on rates inclusive of GST. SCHEDULE OF QUANTITIES S. No D.S.R.No. Description of item Qty Unit Rate in figures & Rate in words Amount 1 13.81 Distempering with 1st quality acrylic distemper (ready mixed) having VOC (Volatile Organic Compound ) content less than 50 gram/ litre, of approved brand and of required shade and colour complete to give and even shade. 420.00 Sqm Rs____________________ Rupees________________ ____________________________ 13.81.1 Old work (one or more coats) 2 13.91 Removing dry or oil bound distemper, water proofing cement paint and the like by scrapping, sand papering and preparing the surface smooth including necessary repairs to scratches etc. complete. 210.00 Sqm Rs____________________ Rupees________________ ____________________________ 3 13.99 Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture of required colour to give an even shade : 60.00 Sqm Rs____________________ Rupees________________ ____________________________ 13.99.1 One or more coats on old work 4 13.12 18 mm cement plaster in two coats under layer 12 mm thick cement plaster 1:5 (1 cement: 5 coarse sand) and a top layer 6 mm thick cement plaster 1:3 (1 cement : 3 coarse sand) finished rough with sponge. 20.00 Sqm Rs____________________ Rupees________________ ____________________________ Total Amount in figures Rs 3 Less Rebate Offered if any_______________________________________________________________________ ___________________________________________________________________________________ in words_____________________________________________________________________________ 1) The estimate amount is inclusive of GST. 2) Comparative statement for Quoted rates shall be based on rates inclusive of GST. Signature of the Contractor sd/- Executive Engineer 4 Terms & Conditions: 1. The work should be completed within thirty (14) days from the date of issue of work order. Failure to complete the work within the stipulated time will entail recovery of compensation from work bills as decided by the University Engineer. 2. The contractor should abide by the Labour Laws, Minimum Wages Act & Workmen’s Compensation Act. 3. This work order can be cancelled and the work stopped at any time by the Officer-in-charge of the work or by any Officer superior to him in authority. 4. The contractor shall permit the University at the time of making intermediate payment(s) to deduct 10% of the value of the work billed for towards Security Deposit. The deposit is liable to be forfeited for non-rectification of defects pointed out to him during the execution of the work/Defect Liability Period. 5. The work shall be done as per CPWD specifications and as directed by the University Engineer from time to time. 6. If water is supplied by the University 1 % of the actual cost of water consuming items will be recovered from the bills for work done. 7. Seignorage charges will be deducted from the bill as per the stipulated rates communicated by the Govt. from time to time. 8. Defect liability period (6) months from the date of completion of the work. 9. For delay or slow progress of work the relevant clauses of CPWD manual will be invoked and penalty levied. 10.No quotation will be accepted without PAN/GST no. 11. GST(2%)/TDS (1% or 2%) / Labour welfare cess (1%) will be levied wherever applicable. Sd/- Executive Engineer CC to: 1. Executive Engineer 1. A.E. Sub-Division (C-) 2. S O (Works & Bills), 3. Finance & Account 4. O.C., 5. D.B.,

सा विद्ा या विमुक्तये । आयासायपरं कर्म विद्यान्ा शिलपनैपुणम् ।। उक्त काव्य पंक्तिययाँ शारङ्गधरपदधति (क्रमांक 4396) में उल्लिखितत हैं. इसमें इसका स्रोतत योगगवासिष्ठ बततायया गयया है. इन काव्यपंक्तिययों का हिंदी रूपांततरण इस ततरह प्रस्तुतत कियया जा सकतता है. “कर्म वही है, जोो बंधन का कारण न होो विद्ा वही है, जोो मुक्ि (मोोक्ष) दिलाए. प्रयतनपूर्वक जोो अन्य कर्म किया जाता है या अन्य विद्ा प्राप्त की जाती है वह मात्र कला-कौशल ही है.” “That is (right) action which does not conduce to bondage (Karmabandaha in the Bhagavadgita sense); that is (true) knowledge which couduces to final liberation or spiritual emancipation; (any) other knowledge implies mere skill in craft.” 31.03.2025 कोो कुलाध्यक्ष भारतत के राष्ट्रपति चीफ रेक्टर ततेलंगगाना के राज्यपाल कुलाधिपति न्याययमूर्ति एल. नरसिमहा रेड्डी प्रकाशितत हुुआ है, जिसमें दिखायया गयया है कि हमारे 29 संकायय/शोोधकर्ता शीर्ष शोोधकर्ताओं की सूचीी में शामिल हैं. एनईपीी का एक उददेश्य व्यावसायिक शिक्षाक्षा सहितत उचच शिक्षाक्षा में सकल नामांकन अनुुपातत कोो 26.3% (2018) से बढ़ाकर 2035 ततक 50% करना है. हमें एनईपीी 2020 का हिससा बनना चाहिए और अन्य उचच शिक्षाक्षा संस्थाानों कोो उनके विकास, सामुुदायिक जुड़ााव और सेवा, अभ्यास के विभिनन क्षेत्रों विज्ान विभाग जैव प्ौद्योगिकी एवं जैव सूचना विज्ान विभाग प्रणालीी एवं कम्प्यूयूटेशनल जीीव विज्ान विभाग प्रति वर्ष, संकाय कोो भारत और विदेशों से हमारीी प्रवेश अधिसूचनाओं के उत्तर में सबसे अधिक आवेदन प्ाप्त होते हैं. शैक्षणिक कार्यक्रमों, पात्रता मानदंडों और प्रवेश प्रक्रिया के साथ-साथ संकाय प्रोफाइल का विवरण संकाय के वेब पेज (http://sls.uohyd.ac.in) से प्ाप्त किया जा सकता है. संकाय ने अपनीी यात्ा पुराने विज्ान परिसर में स्थित एक साधारण परिसर से शुरू की थीी. अब यह 2,38,345 वर्ग फुट के प्लिंथ क्षेत्र वाले एक नए केंद्रीय रूप से वातानुकूलित भवन में परिवर्तित होो गया है. आधुनिक भवन में कुल 65 अनुसंधान प्रयोोगशालाएँ, कक्षााएँ, शिक्षण प्रयोोगशालाएँ, केंद्रीय उपकरण सुविधाएँ, कोशिका और सूक्ष्मजीीव संवर्धन सुविधाएँ, सेमिनार हॉल और सभागार हैं. मचछर प्रजनन सुविधा के साथ एक अतयाधुनिक पशु गृृह, और पूरीी तरह कार्यात्मक और तीीसरे पक्ष दवारा मूलयांकित जैव सुरक्षाा स्तर 3 (बीीएसएल-3) सुविधा, राजसीी जीीव विज्ान संकाय भवन में हाल हीी में जोोडे गए हैं. ये नए परिवर्धन और डीीबीीटीी-बूसट के अधीीन जैव प्ौद्योगिकी विभाग से विशवविदयालय अंतःविषय जीीवन विज्ान विभाग शिक्षाा और अनुसंधान कार्यक्रम (डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर) कार्यक्रम के लिए वित्त पोोषण वास्तव में संकायों के अंतःविषय अनुसंधान कोो बढावा देता है. जीीव विज्ान संकाय के संरक्षण में, कई छात्र विशव स्तर के वैज्ञानिक, अकादमिक नेता और उद्यमीी बन गए. संकाय की फैकल्टीी दवारा किए गए शोोध कार्य अकसर अंतरराष्ट्रीय खयाति प्ाप्त पत्रिकाओं में दिखाई देते हैं और विशव की सर्वश्ेष्ठ प्रतिभाओं का धयान आकर्षित करते हैं, जिसके परिणामसवरूप अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहयोोग स्थापित हुआ है. अधिकांश प्रयोोगशालाओं ने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अनुदान जीते हैं और अधिकांश ने प्रमुख देशों के साथ द्विपक्षीीय वैज्ञानिक सहयोोग में सफलतापूर्वक भाग लिया है. अपने शोोध योोगदान के लिए, संकाय ने भारतीीय विज्ान कांग्ेस एसोसिएशन (ISCA) दवारा स्थापित मिलेनियम पलैकस ऑफ ऑनर, सीीएसआईआर, नई दिल्लीी दवारा दिए गए शांति सवरूप भटनागर पुरसकार सहित कई मान्यताएँ जीतीी हैं. अच्छीी संखया में फैकल्टीी तीीनों प्रमुख विज्ान अकादमियों के फेलोो चुने गए हैं और जेसीी बोोस फेलोशिप; फुलब्ाइट इंटरनेशनल एजुकेशन एडमिनिस्ट्ेटर पुरसकार जैसे प्रतिष्ठित सम्ान जीते हैं. संकाय के अधिकांश विभाग यूजीीसीी- डीीआरएस/डीीएसटीी-एफआईएसटीी योोजनाओं दवारा वित्त पोषित हैं. जीीव विज्ान संकाय विशवविदयालय के अंतर्गत स्थापित उन कुछ संकायों में से एक है जोो डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर कार्यक्रम के अंतर्गत जैव प्ौद्योगिकी विभाग (डीीबीीटीी), नई दिल्लीी से अनुदान प्ाप्त करते हैं. इस शैक्षणिक वर्ष के दौरान, जीीव विज्ान संकाय कोो उद्योोग और सीीएसआईआर, डीीएसटीी, एसईआरबीी, डीीबीीटीी, एमओई और आईसीीएमआर जैसीी सरकारीी वित्त पोोषण एजेंसियों से लगभग 39 करोड़ रुपये का बाहय वित्त पोोषण प्ाप्त हुआ. इसके अलावा, देश में जीीव विज्ान संकाय के मासटर छात्ों ने यूजीीसीी- सीीएसआईआर-नेट परीक्षाा उत्तीर्ण करके प्रभावशालीी प्रदर्शन किया है. छात्ों का चयन प्रधानमंत्री अनुसंधान फैलोशिप के लिए भीी किया जाता है और कई विदेशीी छात्र नियमित रूप से जीीव विज्ान संकाय में शोोध इंटर्नशिप करते हैं. जीीव विज्ान संकाय ने विभिनन वित्त पोोषण एजेंसियों से प्ाप्त धन का प्रभावीी ढंग से उपयोोग कर अतयाधुनिक शिक्षण प्रयोोगशालाएँ, वास्तविक समय पीीसीीआर मशीीन, प्रतिदीप्तिि-सक्रिय सेल सॉर्टिंंग (एफएसीीएस) सुविधा, माइक्रोएरे सपॉटर/ विशलेषक और हाइब्रिडाइजेशन ओवन, अगलीी पीीढ़ीी की अनुक्रमण प्रणालीी, बायोोरुपटर, क्रॉस लिंकर, इलेक्ट्रोपोोरेटर, ल्यूमिनोमीीटर, नॅॅनोो-ड्ॉप मशीीन, एचपीीएलसीी, एफपीीएलसीी और एकेटीी पायलट, सीीडीी स्पेक्ट्रोफोोटोमीीटर, प्रतिदीप्तिि 57 50वाँ वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन स्पेक्ट्रोफोोटोमीीटर, सतह पलास्मोोन अनुनाद, रेडियोोधर्मीी सुविधा, प्रोटिओमिकस-एमएएलडीीआई/एमएस-एमएस/टीीओएफ- कयू केमिडोोक-इमेजिंग सिस्टम, रोोबोटिक क्रिसटलाइजेशन सिस्टम एलसीी-एमएस और जीीसीी-एमएस मेटाबोोलोमिक रिसर्च के लिए, इमेजिंग, ग्रीन हाउस सुविधा और बायोो-सेफ्टीी लेवल थ्री सुविधा (बीीएसएल3) बनाई है. हाल हीी में डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर के सहयोोग से, कई उपकरण खरीदे जा रहे हैं. मेटाबोोलिक फलकस एनालाइज़र, एनिमल हाउस के लिए बुनियादीी ढाँचा - एनेस्थीसिया मशीीन, क्षैैतिज आयताकार स्वचालित सटेरिलाइज़र, लैमिनार फ्लोो सिस्टम. इन केंद्रीय सुविधाओं के अलावा, संकाय कोो परिसर में स्थित नॅॅनोोटेक्नोोलॉजीी केंद्र, सेंट्रल इंस्ट्रूमेंटेशन लैबोोरेटरीी (सीीआईएल) और मॉडलिंग, सिमुलेशन और डिज़ाज़ाइन सेंटर (सीीएमएसडीी) में स्थापित बुनियादीी ढाँचागत सुविधाओं तक पहुँच प्ाप्त है, जिनमें ट्रांांसमिशन इलेक्ट्ॉन माइक्रोस्कोोप (टीीईएम), एटॉमिक फोर्स माइक्रोस्कोोप (एएफएम) और उच्च-स्तरीीय कम्प्यूयूटेशनल सुविधाएँ शामिल हैं. जीीव विज्ान संकाय कई संगोष्ठियों, सम्ेलनों और परिचर्चाओं का आयोोजन कर चुका है. संकाय ने विशव भर से कई प्रतिष्ठित संकाय सदसयों और प्रख्यात वैज्ञानिकों कोो आमंत्रित किया है. जीीवन विज्ान संकाय के डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर आउटरीच कार्यक्रम के अंतर्गत, 17 फ़रवरीी से 21 फ़रवरीी 2025 तक ‘Integrated approaches in understanding protein structure, dynamics, and interaction’ विषय पर एक कार्यशाला का आयोोजन किया जा रहा है. साइटिवा के साथ कार्यशाला – Training on SPR (Biacore) and protein purification system (Akta Pilot) – विषय पर प्रशिक्षण के लिए यह कार्यशाला दिनांक 19 फ़रवरीी से 21 फ़रवरीी, 2025 तक आयोोजित की जाएगीी . संकाय ने एक कौशल विकास केंद्र भीी स्थापित किया है जोो शोोधकर्ताओं और शोोध प्रशिक्षुुओं कोो उनके चुने हुए विषय क्षेेत्ों में प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करता है. शैक्षणिक वर्ष 2024-2025 के दौरान ये प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रम आयोोजित किए गए: ग्रीष्मकालीीन अनुसंधान इंटर्नशिप कार्यक्रम; विज्ान अकादमियों का ग्रीष्मकालीीन सकूल; छात्र प्रेक्षण; फ्लोो पूरीी तरह कार्यात्मक और तीीसरे पक्ष दवारा मूलयांकित जैव सुरक्षाा स्तर 3 (बीीएसएल-3) सुविधा, राजसीी जीीव विज्ान संकाय भवन में हाल हीी में जोोडे गए हैं. ये नए परिवर्धन और डीीबीीटीी-बूसट के अधीीन जैव प्ौद्योगिकी विभाग से विशवविदयालय अंतःविषय जीीवन विज्ान विभाग शिक्षाा और अनुसंधान कार्यक्रम (डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर) कार्यक्रम के लिए वित्त पोोषण वास्तव में संकायों के अंतःविषय अनुसंधान कोो बढावा देता है. जीीव विज्ान संकाय के संरक्षण में, कई छात्र विशव स्तर के वैज्ञानिक, अकादमिक नेता और उद्यमीी बन गए. संकाय की फैकल्टीी दवारा किए गए शोोध कार्य अकसर अंतरराष्ट्रीय खयाति प्ाप्त पत्रिकाओं में दिखाई देते हैं और विशव की सर्वश्ेष्ठ प्रतिभाओं का धयान आकर्षित करते हैं, जिसके परिणामसवरूप अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहयोोग स्थापित हुआ है. अधिकांश प्रयोोगशालाओं ने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अनुदान जीते हैं और अधिकांश ने प्रमुख देशों के साथ द्विपक्षीीय वैज्ञानिक सहयोोग में सफलतापूर्वक भाग लिया है. अपने शोोध योोगदान के लिए, संकाय ने भारतीीय विज्ान कांग्ेस एसोसिएशन (ISCA) दवारा स्थापित मिलेनियम पलैकस ऑफ ऑनर, सीीएसआईआर, नई दिल्लीी दवारा दिए गए शांति सवरूप भटनागर पुरसकार सहित कई मान्यताएँ जीतीी हैं. अच्छीी संखया में फैकल्टीी तीीनों प्रमुख विज्ान अकादमियों के फेलोो चुने गए हैं और जेसीी बोोस फेलोशिप; फुलब्ाइट इंटरनेशनल एजुकेशन एडमिनिस्ट्ेटर पुरसकार जैसे प्रतिष्ठित सम्ान जीते हैं. संकाय के अधिकांश विभाग यूजीीसीी- डीीआरएस/डीीएसटीी-एफआईएसटीी योोजनाओं दवारा वित्त पोषित हैं. जीीव विज्ान संकाय विशवविदयालय के अंतर्गत स्थापित उन कुछ संकायों में से एक है जोो डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर कार्यक्रम के अंतर्गत जैव प्ौद्योगिकी विभाग (डीीबीीटीी), नई दिल्लीी से अनुदान प्ाप्त करते हैं. इस शैक्षणिक वर्ष के दौरान, जीीव विज्ान संकाय कोो उद्योोग और सीीएसआईआर, डीीएसटीी, एसईआरबीी, डीीबीीटीी, एमओई और आईसीीएमआर जैसीी सरकारीी वित्त पोोषण एजेंसियों से लगभग 39 करोड़ रुपये का बाहय वित्त पोोषण प्ाप्त हुआ. इसके अलावा, देश में जीीव विज्ान संकाय के मासटर छात्ों ने यूजीीसीी- सीीएसआईआर-नेट परीक्षाा उत्तीर्ण करके प्रभावशालीी प्रदर्शन किया है. छात्ों का चयन प्रधानमंत्री अनुसंधान फैलोशिप के लिए भीी किया जाता है और कई विदेशीी छात्र नियमित रूप से जीीव विज्ान संकाय में शोोध इंटर्नशिप करते हैं. जीीव विज्ान संकाय ने विभिनन वित्त पोोषण एजेंसियों से प्ाप्त धन का प्रभावीी ढंग से उपयोोग कर अतयाधुनिक शिक्षण प्रयोोगशालाएँ, वास्तविक समय पीीसीीआर मशीीन, प्रतिदीप्तिि-सक्रिय सेल सॉर्टिंंग (एफएसीीएस) सुविधा, माइक्रोएरे सपॉटर/ विशलेषक और हाइब्रिडाइजेशन ओवन, अगलीी पीीढ़ीी की अनुक्रमण प्रणालीी, बायोोरुपटर, क्रॉस लिंकर, इलेक्ट्रोपोोरेटर, ल्यूमिनोमीीटर, नॅॅनोो-ड्ॉप मशीीन, एचपीीएलसीी, एफपीीएलसीी और एकेटीी पायलट, सीीडीी स्पेक्ट्रोफोोटोमीीटर, प्रतिदीप्तिि 57 50वाँ वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन स्पेक्ट्रोफोोटोमीीटर, सतह पलास्मोोन अनुनाद, रेडियोोधर्मीी सुविधा, लेवल थ्री सुविधा (बीीएसएल3) बनाई है. हाल हीी में डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर के सहयोोग से, कई उपकरण खरीदे जा रहे हैं. मेटाबोोलिक फलकस एनालाइज़र, एनिमल हाउस के लिए बुनियादीी ढाँचा - एनेस्थीसिया मशीीन, क्षैैतिज ‘राष्ट्रीय अपेक्षााएँ, वैश्विक मानक’ अपने सभीी हितधारकों: संकाय, छात्ों और गैर-शिक्षण कर्मचारियों के लिए शैक्षणिक, अनुसंधान, बुनियादीी ढाँचे, वित्तीीय और प्रशासनिक सहायता प्रदान करने पर केंद्रित है. विशवविदयालय प्रतिष्ठित संस्ान कोो अपने इतिहास में एक अनूठा अवसर मानता है, जहाँ वह अपनीी मौजूदा प्रतिष्ा, प्रथाओं और सेवाओं का लाभ उठाकर खुद कोो राष्ट्रीय और वैश्विक स्तर पर सर्वश्ेष्ठ और सर्वोच्च श्ेणीी में शामिल कर सकता है. विशवविदयालय ने प्रतिष्ठित संस्ान लक्यों कोो प्ाप्त करने पर अब तक ₹600 करोड़ से अधिक खर्च किए हैं. प्रतिष्ठित संस्ान निधि का एक बडा हिससा मौजूदा उपकरणों के उननयन और शोोध सहायता सहित नए बुनियादीी ढाँचे के निर्माण में निवेश किया गया है; केंद्रीय सुविधाओं से युक्त एक नया अंतःविषयक अनुसंधान केंद्र, सम्ेलनों और नवाचार एवं 127 50वाँ वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन उद्यमिता कोो सक्षम माइक्रो-एकस-रे डिफ्ैक्टोमीीटर, एकस-रे फोोटोोइलेक्ट्ॉन स्पेक्ट्रोमीीटर, ऑप्टिकल माइक्रोस्कोोपीी पलेटफॉर्म, भौतिक गुण मापन प्रणालीी आदि शामिल हैं. कुल 400 संकाय सदसयों में से 250 से अधिक संकाय सदसयों बुद्धिमत्तात्ता के अनुप्रयोोगों पर एक शोोध कलसटर स्थापित किया गया है. लगभग 500 संकाय सदसयों और पीीएच.डीी. छात्ों कोो विदेश में संगोष्ठियों और सम्ेलनों में भाग लेने के लिए ₹1 लाख की यात्ा सहायता दीी कार्यक्रमों और ई-लर्निंंग संसाधनों के विकास कोो वित्तपोषित किया है. प्रशासनिक सर्वोत्तम प्रथाओं, बुनियादीी कौशल, प्रशासनिक, वित्तीीय और अनय कर्मचारियों के कौशल उननयन और पुनर्प्रशिक्षण पर कार्यशालाएँ हैदराबाद विशवविदयालय के स्वर्ण जयंतीी समारोोह के एक भाग के रूप में 50 से अधिक विशिषट वयाखयान आयोोजित किए गए. ये विशिषट वयाखयान नोोबेल पुरसकार विजेताओं, भारत और विदेश के प्रख्यात प्रकाशितत हुुआ है, जिसमें दिखायया गयया है कि हमारे 29 संकायय/शोोधकर्ता शीर्ष शोोधकर्ताओं की सूचीी में शामिल हैं. एनईपीी का एक उददेश्य व्यावसायिक शिक्षाक्षा सहितत उचच शिक्षाक्षा में सकल नामांकन अनुुपातत कोो 26.3% (2018) से बढ़ाकर 2035 ततक 50% करना है. हमें एनईपीी 2020 का हिससा बनना चाहिए और अन्य उचच शिक्षाक्षा संस्थाानों कोो उनके विकास, सामुुदायिक जुड़ााव और सेवा, अभ्यास के विभिनन क्षेत्रों में योगगदान, उचच शिक्षाक्षा प्रणाली के लिलिए संकायय विकास और स्कूल ी शिक्षाक्षा कोो समर्थन देने में सहायतता करनीी चाहिए. आईओई और हमारे रिकॉर्ड के साथ, मैं हैदराबाद विशवविद्यालयय कोो हमारे छात्रों की बेहततरी के लिलिए एनईपीी दवारा परिकल्पितत शिक्षण और अनुुसंधान प्रदान करने की क्पना करतता हूँ. मैं एनईपीी और आईओई अधिदेश दवारा प्रोतसाहितत अंततर्राष्ट्रीययकरण के माध्यम से बेहततर छात्र विविधतता की भीी आशा करतता हूँ, जिससे हम उचच शिक्षाक्षा में एक वैश्विक प्राथमि कतता बन सकेंगगे. हैदराबाद विशवविद्यालयय कोो दियया गयया प्रतिष्ठितत संस्थाान (आईओई) का दर्जा, विशव के सर्वश्ेष्ठ संस्थाानों की श्ेणीी में शामिल होोने के लिलिए हैदराबाद विशवविद्यालयय की स्थिति, योोग्यतता और क्षमतता कोो मान्यतता देतता है. विशवविद्यालयय आईओई कोो अपने इतिहास में एक अनूठठा अवसर मानतता है, जहाँ अपनीी मौजूदा प्रतिष्ठा, प्रथाओं और सेवाओं का लाभ उठठाकर इसे विशव स्तर पर सर्वश्ेष्ठ और उच्चततम श्ेणीी में शामिल कियया जा सकतता है. हमने संकायय सदस्यों के शोोध बुनिययादी ढाँचे में सुुधार के लिलिए रिसर्च कॉल जैसे कई कार्यक्रमों की घोोषणा की है. अब ततक 50 करोड़ रुपयये की 128 परियोोजनाएँ प्रदान की जा चुुकी हैं. नवीीनततम शोोध कॉल अजा/अजजा/ महिलाओं और दिव्यांगग व्यक्तिययों पर केंद्रितत है. शिक्षकों के लिलिए एक व्यावसायिक विकास निधि भीी शुुरू की गगई है. प्रारंभिक चरण में 3 शोोध अध्यक्ष प्रोफेसर भीी नियुुक्त किए गगए हैं. हाल ही में, पीीजीी कार्यक्रम में टॉपर्स के लिलिए स्टूडेंट अचीीवर्स अवार्ड, नॉन-नेट पीीएचडीडी फेलोशि प धारकों के लिलिए प्रकाशन-आधारितत प्रोतसाहन, भारतत के बाहर सम्मेलनों में भागग लेने के लिलिए सभीी हिततधारकों कोो प्रति व्यक्ति 1 लाख रुपयये की अंततर्राष्ट्रीयय ययात्रा सहायतता, कौशल विकास कार्यक्रम पेश करने, ई-लर्ननिंगग संसाधन विकसितत करने, ई-इंफ्रास्ट्रकचर और पुुस्तकालयय संसाधनों कोो बढ़ाने, नए शिक्षण कार्यक्रमों, नवाचार और उद्यमितता कोो समर्थन देने के लिलिए प्रोतसाहन की भीी घोोषणा की गगई है. विज्ान विभाग जैव प्ौद्योगिकी एवं जैव सूचना विज्ान विभाग प्रणालीी एवं कम्प्यूयूटेशनल जीीव विज्ान विभाग प्रति वर्ष, संकाय कोो भारत और विदेशों से हमारीी प्रवेश अधिसूचनाओं के उत्तर में सबसे अधिक आवेदन प्ाप्त होते हैं. शैक्षणिक कार्यक्रमों, पात्रता मानदंडों और प्रवेश प्रक्रिया के साथ-साथ संकाय प्रोफाइल का विवरण संकाय के वेब पेज (http://sls.uohyd.ac.in) से प्ाप्त किया जा सकता है. संकाय ने अपनीी यात्ा पुराने विज्ान परिसर में स्थित एक साधारण परिसर से शुरू की थीी. अब यह 2,38,345 वर्ग फुट के प्लिंथ क्षेत्र वाले एक नए केंद्रीय रूप से वातानुकूलित भवन में परिवर्तित होो गया है. आधुनिक भवन में कुल 65 अनुसंधान प्रयोोगशालाएँ, कक्षााएँ, शिक्षण प्रयोोगशालाएँ, केंद्रीय उपकरण सुविधाएँ, कोशिका और सूक्ष्मजीीव संवर्धन सुविधाएँ, सेमिनार हॉल और सभागार हैं. मचछर प्रजनन सुविधा के साथ एक अतयाधुनिक पशु गृृह, और पूरीी तरह कार्यात्मक और तीीसरे पक्ष दवारा मूलयांकित जैव सुरक्षाा स्तर 3 (बीीएसएल-3) सुविधा, राजसीी जीीव विज्ान संकाय भवन में हाल हीी में जोोडे गए हैं. ये नए परिवर्धन और डीीबीीटीी-बूसट के अधीीन जैव प्ौद्योगिकी विभाग से विशवविदयालय अंतःविषय जीीवन विज्ान विभाग शिक्षाा और अनुसंधान कार्यक्रम (डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर) कार्यक्रम के लिए वित्त पोोषण वास्तव में संकायों के अंतःविषय अनुसंधान कोो बढावा देता है. जीीव विज्ान संकाय के संरक्षण में, कई छात्र विशव स्तर के वैज्ञानिक, अकादमिक नेता और उद्यमीी बन गए. संकाय की फैकल्टीी दवारा किए गए शोोध कार्य अकसर अंतरराष्ट्रीय खयाति प्ाप्त पत्रिकाओं में दिखाई देते हैं और विशव की सर्वश्ेष्ठ प्रतिभाओं का धयान आकर्षित करते हैं, जिसके परिणामसवरूप अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहयोोग स्थापित हुआ है. अधिकांश प्रयोोगशालाओं ने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अनुदान जीते हैं और अधिकांश ने प्रमुख देशों के साथ द्विपक्षीीय वैज्ञानिक सहयोोग में सफलतापूर्वक भाग लिया है. अपने शोोध योोगदान के लिए, संकाय ने भारतीीय विज्ान कांग्ेस एसोसिएशन (ISCA) दवारा स्थापित मिलेनियम पलैकस ऑफ ऑनर, सीीएसआईआर, नई दिल्लीी दवारा दिए गए शांति सवरूप भटनागर पुरसकार सहित कई मान्यताएँ जीतीी हैं. अच्छीी संखया में फैकल्टीी तीीनों प्रमुख विज्ान अकादमियों के फेलोो चुने गए हैं और जेसीी बोोस फेलोशिप; फुलब्ाइट इंटरनेशनल एजुकेशन एडमिनिस्ट्ेटर पुरसकार जैसे प्रतिष्ठित सम्ान जीते हैं. संकाय के अधिकांश विभाग यूजीीसीी- डीीआरएस/डीीएसटीी-एफआईएसटीी योोजनाओं दवारा वित्त पोषित हैं. जीीव विज्ान संकाय विशवविदयालय के अंतर्गत स्थापित उन कुछ संकायों में से एक है जोो डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर कार्यक्रम के अंतर्गत जैव प्ौद्योगिकी विभाग (डीीबीीटीी), नई दिल्लीी से अनुदान प्ाप्त करते हैं. इस शैक्षणिक वर्ष के दौरान, जीीव विज्ान संकाय कोो उद्योोग और सीीएसआईआर, डीीएसटीी, एसईआरबीी, डीीबीीटीी, एमओई और आईसीीएमआर जैसीी सरकारीी वित्त पोोषण एजेंसियों से लगभग 39 करोड़ रुपये का बाहय वित्त पोोषण प्ाप्त हुआ. इसके अलावा, देश में जीीव विज्ान संकाय के मासटर छात्ों ने यूजीीसीी- सीीएसआईआर-नेट परीक्षाा उत्तीर्ण करके प्रभावशालीी प्रदर्शन किया है. छात्ों का चयन प्रधानमंत्री अनुसंधान फैलोशिप के लिए भीी किया जाता है और कई विदेशीी छात्र नियमित रूप से जीीव विज्ान संकाय में शोोध इंटर्नशिप करते हैं. जीीव विज्ान संकाय ने विभिनन वित्त पोोषण एजेंसियों से प्ाप्त धन का प्रभावीी ढंग से उपयोोग कर अतयाधुनिक शिक्षण प्रयोोगशालाएँ, वास्तविक समय पीीसीीआर मशीीन, प्रतिदीप्तिि-सक्रिय सेल सॉर्टिंंग (एफएसीीएस) सुविधा, माइक्रोएरे सपॉटर/ विशलेषक और हाइब्रिडाइजेशन ओवन, अगलीी पीीढ़ीी की अनुक्रमण प्रणालीी, बायोोरुपटर, क्रॉस लिंकर, इलेक्ट्रोपोोरेटर, ल्यूमिनोमीीटर, नॅॅनोो-ड्ॉप मशीीन, एचपीीएलसीी, एफपीीएलसीी और एकेटीी पायलट, सीीडीी स्पेक्ट्रोफोोटोमीीटर, प्रतिदीप्तिि 57 50वाँ वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन स्पेक्ट्रोफोोटोमीीटर, सतह पलास्मोोन अनुनाद, रेडियोोधर्मीी सुविधा, प्रोटिओमिकस-एमएएलडीीआई/एमएस-एमएस/टीीओएफ- कयू केमिडोोक-इमेजिंग सिस्टम, रोोबोटिक क्रिसटलाइजेशन सिस्टम एलसीी-एमएस और जीीसीी-एमएस मेटाबोोलोमिक रिसर्च के लिए, इमेजिंग, ग्रीन हाउस सुविधा और बायोो-सेफ्टीी लेवल थ्री सुविधा (बीीएसएल3) बनाई है. हाल हीी में डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर के सहयोोग से, कई उपकरण खरीदे जा रहे हैं. मेटाबोोलिक फलकस एनालाइज़र, एनिमल हाउस के लिए बुनियादीी ढाँचा - एनेस्थीसिया मशीीन, क्षैैतिज आयताकार स्वचालित सटेरिलाइज़र, लैमिनार फ्लोो सिस्टम. इन केंद्रीय सुविधाओं के अलावा, संकाय कोो परिसर में स्थित नॅॅनोोटेक्नोोलॉजीी केंद्र, सेंट्रल इंस्ट्रूमेंटेशन लैबोोरेटरीी (सीीआईएल) और मॉडलिंग, सिमुलेशन और डिज़ाज़ाइन सेंटर (सीीएमएसडीी) में स्थापित बुनियादीी ढाँचागत सुविधाओं तक पहुँच प्ाप्त है, जिनमें ट्रांांसमिशन इलेक्ट्ॉन माइक्रोस्कोोप (टीीईएम), एटॉमिक फोर्स माइक्रोस्कोोप (एएफएम) और उच्च-स्तरीीय कम्प्यूयूटेशनल सुविधाएँ शामिल हैं. जीीव विज्ान संकाय कई संगोष्ठियों, सम्ेलनों और परिचर्चाओं का आयोोजन कर चुका है. संकाय ने विशव भर से कई प्रतिष्ठित संकाय सदसयों और प्रख्यात वैज्ञानिकों कोो आमंत्रित किया है. जीीवन विज्ान संकाय के डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर आउटरीच कार्यक्रम के अंतर्गत, 17 फ़रवरीी से 21 फ़रवरीी 2025 तक ‘Integrated approaches in understanding protein structure, dynamics, and interaction’ विषय पर एक कार्यशाला का आयोोजन किया जा रहा है. साइटिवा के साथ कार्यशाला – Training on SPR (Biacore) and protein purification system (Akta Pilot) – विषय पर प्रशिक्षण के लिए यह कार्यशाला दिनांक 19 फ़रवरीी से 21 फ़रवरीी, 2025 तक आयोोजित की जाएगीी . संकाय ने एक कौशल विकास केंद्र भीी स्थापित किया है जोो शोोधकर्ताओं और शोोध प्रशिक्षुुओं कोो उनके चुने हुए विषय क्षेेत्ों में प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करता है. शैक्षणिक वर्ष 2024-2025 के दौरान ये प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रम आयोोजित किए गए: ग्रीष्मकालीीन अनुसंधान इंटर्नशिप कार्यक्रम; विज्ान अकादमियों का ग्रीष्मकालीीन सकूल; छात्र प्रेक्षण; फ्लोो साइटोमेट्री पर शरदकालीीन सकूल; बायोोई3 परिचर्चा; पशु कोशिका संवर्धन और औषधि खोोज पर कार्यशाला; प्रोटीीन संरचना, गतिकी और अंतःक्रियाओं पर कार्यशाला; CRISPR-Cas9 प्ौद्योगिकी पर कार्यशाला; जीीव विज्ान में सांख्यिकीय अनुप्रयोोग; स्नातकोोत्तर छात्ों के लिए इंटर्नशिप. इन गहन शैक्षणिक गतिविधियों और उत्कृृषट बुनियादीी ढाँचे के कारण, जीीव विज्ान संकाय कोो 'छात्ों की आकांक्षाा और विदवानों का गंतवय' के रूप में जाना जाता है. प्रो. आनंद के. कोंडापि, जैव प्ौद्योगिकी और जैव सूचना विज्ान विभाग, जीीव विज्ान संकाय के संकाय- अध्यक्ष हैं (उनके प्रोफाइल कोो http://sls.uohyd.ac.in/ पर देखा जा सकता है) 4.4.1 केंद्रीय रूप से वातानुकूलित भवन में परिवर्तित होो गया है. आधुनिक भवन में कुल 65 अनुसंधान प्रयोोगशालाएँ, कक्षााएँ, शिक्षण प्रयोोगशालाएँ, केंद्रीय उपकरण सुविधाएँ, कोशिका और सूक्ष्मजीीव संवर्धन सुविधाएँ, सेमिनार हॉल और सभागार हैं. मचछर प्रजनन सुविधा के साथ एक अतयाधुनिक पशु गृृह, और पूरीी तरह कार्यात्मक और तीीसरे पक्ष दवारा मूलयांकित जैव सुरक्षाा स्तर 3 (बीीएसएल-3) सुविधा, राजसीी जीीव विज्ान संकाय भवन में हाल हीी में जोोडे गए हैं. ये नए परिवर्धन और डीीबीीटीी-बूसट के अधीीन जैव प्ौद्योगिकी विभाग से विशवविदयालय अंतःविषय जीीवन विज्ान विभाग शिक्षाा और अनुसंधान कार्यक्रम (डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर) कार्यक्रम के लिए वित्त पोोषण वास्तव में संकायों के अंतःविषय अनुसंधान कोो बढावा देता है. जीीव विज्ान संकाय के संरक्षण में, कई छात्र विशव स्तर के वैज्ञानिक, अकादमिक नेता और उद्यमीी बन गए. संकाय की फैकल्टीी दवारा किए गए शोोध कार्य अकसर अंतरराष्ट्रीय खयाति प्ाप्त पत्रिकाओं में दिखाई देते हैं और विशव की सर्वश्ेष्ठ प्रतिभाओं का धयान आकर्षित करते हैं, जिसके परिणामसवरूप अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहयोोग स्थापित हुआ है. अधिकांश प्रयोोगशालाओं ने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अनुदान जीते हैं और अधिकांश ने प्रमुख देशों के साथ द्विपक्षीीय वैज्ञानिक सहयोोग में सफलतापूर्वक भाग लिया है. अपने शोोध योोगदान के लिए, संकाय ने भारतीीय विज्ान कांग्ेस एसोसिएशन (isca) दवारा स्थापित मिलेनियम पलैकस ऑफ ऑनर, सीीएसआईआर, नई दिल्लीी दवारा दिए गए शांति सवरूप भटनागर पुरसकार सहित कई मान्यताएँ जीतीी हैं. अच्छीी संखया में फैकल्टीी तीीनों प्रमुख विज्ान अकादमियों के फेलोो चुने गए हैं और जेसीी बोोस फेलोशिप; फुलब्ाइट इंटरनेशनल एजुकेशन एडमिनिस्ट्ेटर पुरसकार जैसे प्रतिष्ठित सम्ान जीते हैं. संकाय के अधिकांश विभाग यूजीीसीी- डीीआरएस/डीीएसटीी-एफआईएसटीी योोजनाओं दवारा वित्त पोषित हैं. जीीव विज्ान संकाय विशवविदयालय के अंतर्गत स्थापित उन कुछ संकायों में से एक है जोो डीीबीीटीी-बिलडर कार्यक्रम के अंतर्गत जैव प्ौद्योगिकी विभाग (डीीबीीटीी), नई दिल्लीी से अनुदान प्ाप्त करते हैं. इस शैक्षणिक वर्ष के दौरान, जीीव विज्ान संकाय कोो उद्योोग और सीीएसआईआर, डीीएसटीी, एसईआरबीी, डीीबीीटीी, एमओई और आईसीीएमआर जैसीी सरकारीी वित्त पोोषण एजेंसियों से लगभग 39 करोड़ रुपये का बाहय वित्त पोोषण प्ाप्त हुआ. इसके अलावा, देश में जीीव विज्ान संकाय के मासटर छात्ों ने यूजीीसीी- सीीएसआईआर-नेट परीक्षाा उत्तीर्ण करके प्रभावशालीी प्रदर्शन किया है. छात्ों का चयन प्रधानमंत्री अनुसंधान फैलोशिप के लिए भीी किया जाता है और कई विदेशीी छात्र नियमित रूप से जीीव विज्ान संकाय में शोोध इंटर्नशिप करते हैं. जीीव विज्ान संकाय ने विभिनन वित्त पोोषण एजेंसियों से प्ाप्त धन का प्रभावीी ढंग से उपयोोग कर अतयाधुनिक शिक्षण प्रयोोगशालाएँ, वास्तविक समय पीीसीीआर मशीीन, प्रतिदीप्तिि-सक्रिय सेल सॉर्टिंंग (एफएसीीएस) सुविधा, माइक्रोएरे सपॉटर/ विशलेषक और हाइब्रिडाइजेशन ओवन, अगलीी पीीढ़ीी की अनुक्रमण Statement showing the number of students on 62 rolls Course/Subject/Category and gender wise vi From the Vice-Chancellor’s Desk I'm delighted to present the University of Hyderabad's annual report, highlighting our remarkable progress in education and research. As we complete four successful years of the Institution of Eminence (IoE) project, we're poised to reach new heights. Global Recognition Our university's consistent focus on quality research and teaching has earned us a spot in the QS Rankings 2026, with a ranking of 801-850 globally. We're among the top universities worldwide and ranked 18th among Indian universities in the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) 2025. Our research publications have secured us the top spot among multidisciplinary Indian universities in the Nature Index 2025 ranking. Student Strength and Diversity This year, our student strength stands at 5,750, with 30.5% research scholars pursuing Ph.D. and M.Tech programs. Women students comprise 46.2% of the total strength, while 27.5% of students belong to reserved Basuthkar Jagadeeshwar Rao Vice-Chancellor, University of Hyderabad vii Prof. C. R. Rao Road, Gachibowli Central University P.O. Hyderabad – 500 046. categories (SC/ST/PH) and 37.5% from OBC categories. We've also seen a significant increase in international students, with 250 students enrolled in various programs. The University of Hyderabad has successfully uploaded a total of 44800 records of the Degrees awarded to the Digilocker NAD. All Degrees awarded from 1977 to 2024 have been uploaded. Our university is now part of the Ministry’s CUET for the admissions. I am happy to inform you all that the University has received close to 30,999 applications for all courses other than PhD. Research Excellence Our faculty, numbering over 400, produced more than 562 research publications including 70 books, during the year. Our faculty have been associated with several important national and international bodies, held Professorships of distinction, both in India and abroad, and participated in the global educational arena with as much vigour as we have always done. Furthermore, they have been funded quite handsomely receiving grants from national and international funding agencies like UGC, MHRD, DBT, DST, EU, DoE, IUSSTF and so on. The University’s current extramural R&D funding is about Rs. 350 crores. Our long-term vision and mission is “National Needs, Global Standards”. Our core values seek innovation and interdisciplinary, integrating hard sciences with humanistic studies and social inquiry, reinvigorating literary and linguistic studies with digital technology. University’s research work aspires to global standards in order to truly fulfil national needs. I am delighted to record here a recent study by Stanford and published in the highly respected journal PLOS Biology shows 29 of our faculty/researchers figure in the list of top researchers. Institution of Eminence Initiatives The University of Hyderabad's Institution of Eminence (IoE) status is a huge recognition of its standing and potential to join the world's best institutions. To leverage this, the university has announced several initiatives, including research calls to boost faculty research infrastructure, with 128 projects worth ₹50 crores already awarded. The latest research call focuses on SC/ST/Women and persons with disability. The university is also working on internationalization through the IoE Chair Professor and International Fellows scheme, and enhancing industry involvement through public-private partnerships and research clusters. New infrastructure developments are Inter-disciplinary centre; HRDC building; International guest house; Administrative building and Hostels for boys and girls. NEP 2020 and IoE Initiatives We're committed to implementing the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, focusing on interdisciplinary research, innovation, and community engagement. Under the IoE project, we've launched new programs, viii ix including research calls, professional development funds for teachers, and student achiever awards. We've also initiated internationalization efforts, including the IoE Chair Professor and International Fellows scheme. Infrastructure Development We're expanding our infrastructure with new buildings, including an interdisciplinary center, HRDC building, international guest house, and hostels. These developments will enhance our research and teaching capabilities. Looking Ahead As we strive to become a global leader in higher education, our vision of "National Needs, Global Standards" aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). I congratulate our faculty, students, and staff for their tireless efforts and dedication to excellence. I look forward to even greater achievements for the University of Hyderabad.
